name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_is_capable_of_providing_informed_consent_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently capable of providing informed consent.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently capable of providing informed consent.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not capable of providing informed consent.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently capable of providing informed consent.

when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not capable of giving competent informed consent, as determined by clinical or cognitive assessment.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently capable of giving competent informed consent.

name: patient_mini_mental_state_examination_score_value_recorded_now_withunit_score
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current Mini Mental State Examination (MMSE) score.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such MMSE score measurement recorded now is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured MMSE score value if a numeric measurement of the Mini Mental State Examination score recorded now is available.

name: patient_is_not_capable_of_giving_competent_informed_consent_due_to_mmse_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently not capable of giving competent informed consent due to MMSE score < 24.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's Mini Mental State Examination score recorded now is less than 24.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's Mini Mental State Examination score recorded now is 24 or greater.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's Mini Mental State Examination score is not available or indeterminate.
